content:
Hi all

Together with @Matteo Cipollina and @Freek Wiedijk I formalized Hopfield networks and Boltzmann machines in Lean. The paper just got into LPAR-26 https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.07766v2, the final version is submitted and will be online tomorrow), code is here: https://github.com/mkaratarakis/HNBM. There's an old draft PR #664 in PhysLib from July 2025 with the neural network framework and the Hopfield part bridged to CanonicalEnsemble. It's quite big, and the code has changed a lot since. Boltzmann machines aren't in it, they need Perron–Frobenius which is still under review in mathlib, so they'd come later. I would like to re-introduce the material in small PRs. Is this something you'd still like to have in PhysLib?

Firstly, congratulations on getting your paper into LPAR-26! My view on this is that we certainly want the physics from this within Physlib encoded in a way that is applicable more generally for physics. I think the best thing to do here is to start making the small pull requests, and then we can go from there.
Thanks a lot Joe! I'll start with the basic neural network definitions and close #664 once the first PR is up
